name: Skyline FD Certificate - 36-Month Plan
description: Soulbound certificate for a 36-month fixed deposit with Skyline Bank of India (SBOI), a fictional bank created for an NCI Blockchain Technologies project. It proves the deposit exists and when it matures. The deposit itself stays in the bank's core banking system; no name or amount is stored on-chain. The certificate cannot be transferred and is burned at maturity, when Skyline Maturity Miles are paid.

attributes.value: 1 token per Rs 200 per year, capped at 2,000 tokens
